query: CDC Salmonella outbreak investigation 2024 cases hospitalizations deaths United States May June July
query_rationale: CDC is the primary US federal authority for Salmonella surveillance. Its outbreak investigation pages and MMWR reports are the highest-trust source for confirmed case counts, hospitalization rates, deaths, and subnational location breakdowns. Targeting CDC directly without rigid quoting maximizes recall of relevant pages published in or covering May–July 2024.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC outbreak investigation pages, MMWR reports, CDC FoodNet surveillance summaries
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, MMWR publication, official outbreak investigation notice

query: FDA Salmonella outbreak recall advisory 2024 cases United States May June July food vehicle
query_rationale: FDA issues outbreak advisories and recall notices for food-vehicle-linked Salmonella outbreaks, often including case counts, affected states, and hospitalization data. Many US Salmonella outbreaks in summer months are linked to produce, eggs, or poultry. FDA advisories frequently cross-reference CDC investigation data and provide subnational location detail.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: FDA outbreak advisory pages, FDA food safety alerts, FDA recall notices with epidemiological data
expected_trust_signal: fda.gov domain, official outbreak advisory or recall notice with case count data

query: Salmonella multistate outbreak United States 2024 cases deaths hospitalizations state health department
query_rationale: A broad web search without rigid quoting will surface state health department advisories, ProMED posts, PAHO event notices, and aggregator pages (e.g., Outbreak News Today) that report Salmonella multistate outbreaks in the US during 2024. This captures subnational location data and corroborating case counts that may not appear in CDC/FDA pages alone. Avoiding exact-phrase quoting improves recall across varied agency naming conventions.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: State health department press releases, ProMED posts, PAHO event notices, public health news aggregators
expected_trust_signal: State .gov domains, ProMED archive, PAHO PAHO.int, named public health official quotes with case counts
